Team —

Quick ask: Sales enablement wants 8–10 short, punchy customer lines we can use in a one-pager and slide deck (1–2 sentences each). Goal: surface outcomes we can call out on a single slide and a downloadable one-pager for the sales kit.

Requirements:
- One-liner (30–70 words) that mentions outcome (latency/cost/throughput/accuracy) + company name
- Named contact who has already approved a quote or is ok to be pinged for permission
- Any existing supporting metric (e.g., "reduced per-token cost by 3x") if available

Please reply with candidates and attach any permission emails/screenshots you already have. If you already asked the customer, paste the exact quote and the date they approved.

Target: compile draft by Tuesday (6/16) so enablement can build the one-pager for next week's SDR play.

Thanks —
